chambers.oriented_wall_lattice: the archived fixed lattice, exactly isometric to U+E8(-2)+<-4> by its complete discriminant form and Nikulin uniqueness

scope.minus_two_roots: Riemann--Roch supplies an effective sign after Weyl framing, but no irreducibility or complete-nef assertion is made here
scope.not_full_nef: the 123-wall and 84-wall systems contain square-minus-four mirrors and are only mixed divisor-reflection chambers
scope.not_surface_automorphisms: integral Picard reflections are not asserted to extend to Hodge isometries or automorphisms of a K3 surface
scope.positive_gain: two known abstract cofinite H10 chambers now share one characteristic-zero very-general full-Picard K3 family
scope.wall_span_index: each displayed wall-normal set spans an index-two sublattice of S, while every displayed reflection acts integrally on all of S

minimal_even_scaled_dual.note: This scaled dual is recorded for the carrier census; the positive K3 carrier uses S itself, whose discriminant is much smaller.

period_consequence.reason: the primitive embedding has complement signature (2,9); period surjectivity and avoidance of the countable extra-algebraic hyperplanes give NS exactly S

primitive_K3_embedding.embedding_description: U is the first ambient U; E8(-2) is diagonal in the two E8(-1) factors; <-4> is generated by e-2f in the second U

theorem: The known finite-volume noncompact F3-V4 H10/123 and Jacobian--Kummer class-0007 H10/84 chambers share the even lattice S=U+E8(-2)+<-4>.  The displayed primitive embedding S->Lambda_K3 and K3 period surjectivity give a nine-dimensional family whose very general member has full NS=S.  Both complete oriented wall systems and all their integral reflections therefore act on the full Picard lattice.
